records.title: China’s Military Strategy (中国的军事战略) — State Council Defense White Paper
records.author_org: State Council Information Office of the PRC
records.description:
China’s first topical defense white paper dedicated specifically to military strategy (>9,000 Chinese characters, 6 chapters). Formally shifts the PLAN’s strategic requirement from ‘offshore waters defense’ to a combination of ‘offshore waters defense’ (近海防御) and ‘open seas protection’ (远海护卫), introduces ‘areas crucially related to China’s overseas interests’ (海外利益攸关区), and identifies four critical security domains (ocean, outer space, cyberspace, nuclear force).

**Recovered quotation provenance.** The actual English policy paragraph quoted in the fourth- and fifth-edition aerospace primers is present in sectionIV of this 2015 white paper, while both printed notes attribute it to the 2013 Academy strategy textbook. The earlier book contains related ideas but the full quoted English paragraph was not recovered there. This is a quotation-provenance finding, not an added claim that either primer originally cited the white paper. The original printed citations and their source keys are preserved. See [fourth-edition note 9](#audit?type=footnote&batch=14&paper=CASI-B14-07&row=CASIB1407-N0009) and [fifth-edition note 54](#audit?type=footnote&batch=14&paper=CASI-B14-19&row=CASIB1419-N0054) for the comparison and remaining pinpoint gap.
